title: 청자 음인각 모란무늬 매병 — 원본 사진 기반 3D 재현
displayNoticeKo: 원본 사진 기반 3D 재현 · 형상·안쪽 일부 추정
purpose: Continuous free rotation between the discrete original photograph viewpoints, using a local embedded GLB. The original 54 photographs remain available for evidence and comparison.

cameraRecovery.scale: arbitrary; no physical dimensions are inferred

construction.geometry: A smooth radial profile and low-order azimuthal asymmetry fitted to 18,965 filtered feature points recovered from 45 calibrated photographs. 192 angular segments provide continuous geometry. A real open mouth and estimated closed bottom/interior are modeled.
construction.outerLip: Uneven outer-lip heights are derived from photographed feature points; wall thickness and between-feature shape are approximate.
construction.underside: The 9 inverted underside photographs did not register. Original 5_4.jpg is separately aligned to an approximate shallow circular foot. This alignment is manual, not recovered photogrammetry.
construction.interior: Unseen interior is an estimated neutral dark ceramic cavity, without invented painted or incised decoration.
construction.scale: Normalized arbitrary units; this model is not suitable for physical measurements.

appearance.encoding: JPEG quality 93, 4:4:4 chroma; embedded in GLB
appearance.bodyTexture: Calibrated projection from all 45 registered original photographs, weighted by front-facing surface angle. Foreground masks reject white source backgrounds.
appearance.lighting: KHR_materials_unlit retains photographic colors and baked highlights without adding duplicate scene lighting. This is not a physically measured glaze material.
appearance.undersideTexture: Separately projected original 5_4.jpg; manually annotated foot-disc ellipse excludes the sloped body.
appearance.runtimeColorHandling: The exhibit sets preservePhotoColors; cloned unlit photographic materials bypass ACES tone mapping (toneMapped=false) while retaining sRGB texture decoding/output. Lit exhibits keep their existing scene tone mapping.

validation.topologyNote: Boundary and manifold checks weld coincident UV-seam and axis-cap vertices. The vessel wall is a closed solid surface while the mouth remains visibly open into its modeled interior.
validation.visualReview: Front, quarter, opposite, top, and underside renders compared with original photographs. Smooth shoulder/foot transitions and underside-disc projection reviewed.

rebuildFromArchivedInputs.description: Complete 4K rebuild from extracted repository input archive and unchanged source JPEGs reproduced the approved GLB byte for byte; no scratch-only inputs required.

reproduction.inputContents: Recovered cameras, fitted radial/asymmetry profile, 46 foreground masks, recovery summary, and input hashes. Uses the 54 unchanged source photographs already stored in this repository.

limitations: This is an approximate photo-derived reconstruction, not the museum's measured scan or original 3D mesh.
Small silhouette, chip depth, incised-line depth, and motif-position differences may remain. Incised decoration is primarily photographic texture, not measured relief.
Inside shape, wall thickness, underside-foot geometry, and alignment of the unregistered underside photograph are partly estimated.
Source illumination and highlights are baked into the texture; projected photographic regions can retain local blending or seam artifacts.
Use the original 54 photographs for close observation and evidence. This model has no reliable physical scale.
rights: Follow the original National Museum of Korea usage terms; no new license granted.
